title: Venus in Aries
caption: venus in aries doesn't do slow burns. it knows in five minutes and hates pretending otherwise

lines: You knew in the first *five minutes,*
and you hate pretending you didn't.
That's Venus in Aries.
Venus sits in the sign Mars rules,
so love, for you, is a *pursuit.*
Mixed signals don't feel mysterious.
They feel like a *no.*
Say it with me.
I want to be *chosen* on purpose,
not kept around just in case.
My excitement is not *too much.*
It's how I know it's *real.*

title: Venus in Taurus
caption: venus in taurus is not impressed by fireworks. it is impressed by the same warm text every night

lines: Grand gestures don't really move you.
*Consistency* does.
The same warm text, the same booth,
the hand already reaching for yours.
Venus rules Taurus,
so here she's *home,* and in no hurry.
You need love you can touch,
taste, and count on.
Slow isn't boring to you. Slow is *safe.*
Say it with me.
I'm allowed to want *steady.*
The right person won't find me *slow.*
They'll find me *worth staying* for.

title: Venus in Gemini
caption: venus in gemini falls in love mid-conversation. bore them and they're already gone

lines: The way to your heart is a *good question.*
Then another. Then a voice note at midnight
about something you said last week.
Gemini is ruled by Mercury,
the planet of talk.
So you fall in love *out loud,*
through banter and tangents and jokes.
Boredom isn't small to you. It's *distance.*
Say it with me.
I want someone who stays *curious*
about me, long after the first date.
My mind is part of my *heart.*

title: Venus in Cancer
caption: venus in cancer knows how everyone takes their tea. it would love for someone to know theirs

lines: Who remembers how *you* take your tea?
You know everyone else's by heart.
That's the quiet question of Venus in *Cancer.*
Cancer is ruled by the Moon
and belongs to the fourth house, *home.*
So you love like a shell around someone,
and you need one around *you,* too.
Say it with me.
I'm allowed to be *cared for*
the way I care for everyone else.
My softness is a *home,*
and I get to choose who stays.

title: Venus in Leo
cover: Venus in Leo wants to be *adored*
caption: venus in leo doesn't want to be liked. it wants to be someone's favorite, out loud

lines: Being *liked* was never the goal.
You want to be *adored.*
And honestly, that isn't vanity.
Leo is ruled by the Sun,
and you love the way the sun does:
warm, generous, impossible to miss.
So you need a love that *shines back,*
not one that dims you to feel bigger.
Say it with me.
I deserve to be someone's *favorite,*
said out loud, in front of people.
I will never shrink to be *loved.*

title: Venus in Virgo
caption: venus in virgo fixed the shelf before it ever said i love you. it meant the same thing

lines: You fixed their *shelf*
before you ever said I love you.
With Venus in Virgo,
love is a *verb* before it's a word.
So you need someone who *notices.*
The refilled water glass.
The way you remembered their big day.
And who lets you rest without *earning* it.
Say it with me.
I don't have to be *perfect*
to be worth loving.
I get to be *helped,* too.

title: Venus in Libra
caption: venus in libra knows who texted last, who picked dinner, who said sorry first. it just wants it even

lines: You notice the second the scales *tip.*
Who texted last. Who picked dinner.
Who said sorry *first.*
Venus rules Libra, so she's home here,
in the seventh sign, the sign of partners.
You don't want someone to complete you.
You want someone to *meet* you halfway.
Say it with me.
I want a love that's *even,*
where keeping the peace isn't *my* job alone.
I can ask for what's *fair.*

title: Venus in Scorpio
caption: venus in scorpio would trade a hundred easy conversations for one real one. it doesn't do halfway

lines: You'd rather have one *real* conversation
than a hundred easy ones.
Venus in Scorpio doesn't do *halfway.*
Scorpio belongs to the eighth house:
intimacy, trust, what two people share.
So you love all the way *down,*
and you need someone who won't flinch
when they finally see it.
Say it with me.
My depth is an *invitation,* not a warning.
I'm allowed to trust *slowly,*
and to love *completely* once I do.

title: Venus in Sagittarius
caption: venus in sagittarius falls in love in airports and on long drives. the right one books the second ticket

lines: Long drives. Airports. A debate at *midnight.*
That's where you fall in love.
Venus in Sagittarius needs room.
Sagittarius is ruled by Jupiter,
the planet of *more:* more sky, more truth.
So a cage, even a sweet one, feels like *goodbye.*
You need a love that comes *with* you.
So stop apologizing for needing *room.*
The right person won't hold you back.
They'll book the *second* ticket.

title: Venus in Capricorn
caption: venus in capricorn doesn't say i love you early. it says it when it can keep it

lines: You don't say I love you *early.*
You say it when you can *keep* it.
Venus in Capricorn loves like a *builder.*
Capricorn is ruled by Saturn,
the planet of *time.*
So you trust what lasts, not what *sparkles.*
You need someone who shows up
long after it stops being new.
So no, you're not *cold.*
You just don't hand out promises
you can't keep.
And that's the most romantic thing there is.

title: Venus in Aquarius
caption: venus in aquarius fell for someone in a group chat. friends first, then slowly, everything

lines: Your best love story started in a *group chat.*
Friends first. Then, slowly, *everything.*
Aquarius belongs to the eleventh house,
the house of friends and hopes.
Its modern ruler is Uranus,
the planet of the *unexpected.*
So you need a partner who is also your *person,*
who can give you room without feeling left.
Say it with me.
I can be *close* and still be *me.*
Needing space doesn't mean I care *less.*

title: Venus in Pisces
caption: venus in pisces has loved people for who they could be. it deserves someone who already is

lines: Venus is *exalted* in Pisces,
the sign where she's at her best,
where love has *no edges* at all.
You've loved people for who they *could* be.
You feel their day before they say a word,
and you love by *merging.*
So you need someone gentle with that,
who meets your softness with *care.*
Say it with me.
I can love *without* disappearing.
I don't have to rescue anyone
to deserve being *held.*
